description: Retrieves a display-friendly representation of an existing and accessible Trello action for UI/report purposes, providing presentation-focused data instead of full raw details and without altering the action.

idAction.description: The unique identifier of the Trello action for which display information is to be retrieved.
idAction.title: Id Action

name: get_actions_display_by_id_action

entities.description: A dictionary of entity names to entity objects containing contextual information about objects involved in the action (cards, boards, lists, members, dates, etc.). Each entity has type and relevant data fields.
entities.title: Entities

translationKey.description: The translation key describing the action type (e.g., 'action_comment_on_card', 'action_changed_a_due_date').
translationKey.title: Translation Key
